answer: The strongest lever is simple: mix in randomly chosen human-authored live tasks that cannot be precomputed, because grove only stays cheap while clones that dodge the live lane lose the epoch payout entirely. Concretely, beacon is enforced in the ledger: Jurors see the identity's full answer chain, so a template match is detectable in one pass. Any knoll approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
